definitions.text_en: to enter, come in, go in, penetrate
definitions.text_mt: Jgħaddi minn barra għal ġewwa f'post magħluq, jew jissieħeb f'ħidma jew f'għaqda.

usage_examples.mt: Daħal fil-kamra bil-mod biex ma jqajjimx lit-tarbija.
usage_examples.en: He entered the room quietly so as not to wake the baby.
usage_examples.text_mt: Daħal fil-kamra bil-mod biex ma jqajjimx lit-tarbija.
usage_examples.text_en: He entered the room quietly so as not to wake the baby.

usage_notes.mt: Użat ukoll b'mod figurattiv għal min jibda xogħol jew jissieħeb f'għaqda, bħal 'daħal f'xogħol'.
usage_notes.en: Also used figuratively for starting work or joining an organization, as in 'daħal f'xogħol'.

definitions.text_en: to arrive, reach a destination, get to
definitions.text_mt: Jilħaq il-post jew id-destinazzjoni li jkun sejjer lejha wara vjaġġ jew mixja.

usage_examples.mt: Il-vapur wasal fil-port kmieni filgħodu.
usage_examples.en: The ship arrived in port early in the morning.
usage_examples.text_mt: Il-vapur wasal fil-port kmieni filgħodu.
usage_examples.text_en: The ship arrived in port early in the morning.

definitions.text_en: to deliver, bring, convey, give a lift to
definitions.text_mt: Jieħu persuna jew oġġett sal-post iddestinat, jew jgħaddi messaġġ lil ħaddieħor.

usage_examples.mt: Missieri wassalni l-iskola bil-karozza dalgħodu.
usage_examples.en: My father drove me to school this morning.
usage_examples.text_mt: Missieri wassalni l-iskola bil-karozza dalgħodu.
usage_examples.text_en: My father drove me to school this morning.

definitions.text_en: to walk, go on foot, proceed, function
definitions.text_mt: Iċaqlaq riġlejh wieħed wara l-ieħor biex javvanza fuq l-art, jew jaħdem u jibqa' għaddej b'mod regolari.

usage_examples.mt: Imxejna tul ix-xatt għal nofs siegħa sħiħa.
usage_examples.en: We walked along the promenade for a full half hour.
usage_examples.text_mt: Imxejna tul ix-xatt għal nofs siegħa sħiħa.
usage_examples.text_en: We walked along the promenade for a full half hour.

definitions.text_en: to pass, cross, go past, pass an exam, hand over
definitions.text_mt: Jaqsam minn naħa għal oħra, imur lil hinn minn post jew limitu, jew jirnexxi f'prova u f'eżami.

usage_examples.mt: Għaddejna minn ħdejn il-knisja qabel ma bdejna l-mixja.
usage_examples.en: We passed by the church before starting the walk.
usage_examples.text_mt: Għaddejna minn ħdejn il-knisja qabel ma bdejna l-mixja.
usage_examples.text_en: We passed by the church before starting the walk.

definitions.text_en: to fall, drop, collapse, tumble
definitions.text_mt: Jinżel 'l isfel bla ma jkun miżmum u jaħbat mal-art taħt il-piż tiegħu.

usage_examples.mt: It-tazza waqgħet minn fuq il-mejda u tkissret.
usage_examples.en: The glass fell off the table and broke.
usage_examples.text_mt: It-tazza waqgħet minn fuq il-mejda u tkissret.
usage_examples.text_en: The glass fell off the table and broke.

definitions.text_en: to reach, catch up with, attain, make it in time
definitions.text_mt: Jasal sa punt jew għan mixtieq, jaqbad ma' xi ħadd li jkun quddiemu, jew jasal fil-ħin stabbilit.

usage_examples.mt: Laħaq il-karozza tal-linja fl-aħħar sekonda.
usage_examples.en: He caught the bus at the last second.
usage_examples.text_mt: Laħaq il-karozza tal-linja fl-aħħar sekonda.
usage_examples.text_en: He caught the bus at the last second.

usage_notes.mt: Użat ukoll b'kompliment ta' kariga fis-sens li persuna tieħu ħatra jew pożizzjoni uffiċjali.
usage_notes.en: Also used with an office or rank complement to mean attaining a position.

definitions.text_en: to follow, pursue, track, keep up with
definitions.text_mt: Jimxi wara xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, jisma' u jżomm għajnejh fuq ġrajjiet, jew ikompli kors ta' tagħlim.

usage_examples.mt: Segwejna l-mappa biex insibu t-triq it-tajba.
usage_examples.en: We followed the map to find the right road.
usage_examples.text_mt: Segwejna l-mappa biex insibu t-triq it-tajba.
usage_examples.text_en: We followed the map to find the right road.

definitions.text_en: to regulate, govern, adjust, control

usage_examples.mt: Il-liġi l-ġdida tirregola t-traffiku fiċ-ċentru tal-belt.

definitions.text_en: entry, entrance, income, admission
definitions.text_mt: L-att li wieħed jgħaddi minn barra għal ġewwa, il-permess ta' aċċess f'post, jew il-qligħ finanzjarju li jinġabar.

usage_examples.mt: Id-dħul għall-mużew huwa b'xejn nhar ta' Ħadd.

definitions.text_en: entrance, doorway, inlet, driveway
definitions.text_mt: Il-fetħa, il-bieb jew il-passaġġ li minnu wieħed jgħaddi minn barra għal ġewwa f'bini, proprjetà jew bajja.

usage_examples.mt: Stenna ħdejn id-daħla prinċipali tal-iskola.

usage_examples.mt: Is-sena d-dieħla se nżuru lil qrabatna barra minn Malta.
usage_examples.en: Next year we will visit our relatives abroad.
usage_examples.text_mt: Is-sena d-dieħla se nżuru lil qrabatna barra minn Malta.

usage_notes.en: Frequently placed after a time noun (as in 'is-sena d-dieħla', 'next year') to express immediate future.

definitions.text_en: entered, engaged in, deep inside, familiar with

usage_examples.mt: Huwa midħul sewwa fix-xogħol tal-komunità lokali.

definitions.text_en: arrival, coming, reaching a destination

usage_examples.mt: Il-wasla tat-titjira ttardjat b'nofs siegħa minħabba r-riħ.
usage_examples.en: The arrival of the flight was delayed by half an hour due to the wind.

definitions.text_en: delivery, conveyance, handing over, giving a lift

usage_examples.mt: Il-pakkett wasal id-dar imwassal fil-ħin stabbilit.

definitions.text_en: a walk, stroll, gait, manner of walking

definitions.text_en: insertion, introduction, inclusion, importation
definitions.text_mt: It-tqegħid ta' ħaġa ġewwa spazju magħluq, l-introduzzjoni ta' sistema ġdida, jew iż-żieda ta' tagħrif f'reġistru.

usage_examples.mt: It-tdaħħil tas-sistema l-ġdida ħa diversi ġimgħat.
usage_examples.en: The introduction of the new system took several weeks.
usage_examples.text_mt: It-tdaħħil tas-sistema l-ġdida ħa diversi ġimgħat.
usage_examples.text_en: The introduction of the new system took several weeks.

definitions.text_en: inserted, included, introduced, advanced in age
definitions.text_mt: Li ġie mqiegħed ġewwa jew miżjud f'reġistru, u b'mod idjomatiku ma' 'fiż-żmien' ifisser xih.

usage_examples.mt: Anki jekk huwa mdaħħal fiż-żmien, baqa' attiv ħafna.
usage_examples.en: Even though he is advanced in age, he remained very active.
usage_examples.text_mt: Anki jekk huwa mdaħħal fiż-żmien, baqa' attiv ħafna.
usage_examples.text_en: Even though he is advanced in age, he remained very active.

usage_notes.mt: Fl-espressjoni 'mdaħħal fiż-żmien' ifisser persuna ta' età kbira jew xiha.
usage_notes.en: In the idiom 'mdaħħal fiż-żmien', it means 'elderly' or 'advanced in years'.

definitions.text_en: interference, meddling, intrusion, intervention
definitions.text_mt: L-intervent mhux mitlub jew it-tħabbit f'affarijiet privati ta' ħaddieħor bla dritt u bla permess.

usage_examples.mt: Ma jogħġobnix l-indħil żejjed fil-ħajja privata tan-nies.
usage_examples.en: I do not like excessive meddling in people's private lives.
usage_examples.text_mt: Ma jogħġobnix l-indħil żejjed fil-ħajja privata tan-nies.
usage_examples.text_en: I do not like excessive meddling in people's private lives.

usage_notes.mt: Jieħu 'i-' ewfonika wara l-artiklu jew konsonanti, bħal 'l-indħil'.
usage_notes.en: Takes euphonic 'i-' after the definite article or a consonant, as in 'l-indħil'.

definitions.text_en: leadership, management, direction, governance
definitions.text_mt: L-amministrazzjoni, it-tħaddim u d-direzzjoni ta' organizzazzjoni, proġett jew tim ta' nies.

usage_examples.mt: Taħt it-tmexxija l-ġdida l-iskola għamlet progress kbir.
usage_examples.en: Under the new leadership the school made great progress.
usage_examples.text_mt: Taħt it-tmexxija l-ġdida l-iskola għamlet progress kbir.
usage_examples.text_en: Under the new leadership the school made great progress.

definitions.text_en: led, managed, directed, guided
definitions.text_mt: Li huwa gwidat, amministrat u mħaddem taħt il-ħarsien u d-direzzjoni ta' xi ħadd.

usage_examples.mt: L-uffiċċju huwa mmexxi minn tim żgħir imma effiċjenti.
usage_examples.en: The office is run by a small but efficient team.
usage_examples.text_mt: L-uffiċċju huwa mmexxi minn tim żgħir imma effiċjenti.

definitions.text_en: demolition, tearing down, dropping, knocking down
definitions.text_mt: It-tiġrif intenzjonat ta' bini u strutturi, jew it-twaddib ta' ħaġa 'l isfel lejn l-art.

usage_examples.mt: Ix-xogħol tat-twaqqigħ tal-ħajt beda kmieni dalgħodu.
usage_examples.en: Work on demolishing the wall began early this morning.
usage_examples.text_mt: Ix-xogħol tat-twaqqigħ tal-ħajt beda kmieni dalgħodu.
usage_examples.text_en: Work on demolishing the wall began early this morning.

definitions.text_en: dropped, knocked down, demolished
definitions.text_mt: Li ġie mġarraf mal-art, imkisser jew imniżżel 'l isfel.

usage_examples.mt: Is-siġar mwaqqgħin mir-riħ għalqu t-triq prinċipali.
usage_examples.en: The trees knocked down by the wind blocked the main road.

definitions.text_en: promotion, appointment, keeping up with, coping
definitions.text_mt: Il-ħatra ta' persuna f'kariga ogħla, jew il-kapaċità li wieħed iżomm pass mal-ħidma u l-ispejjeż fil-ħin.

usage_examples.mt: It-tlaħħiq mal-ispejjeż sar aktar diffiċli din is-sena.
usage_examples.en: Keeping up with expenses became harder this year.
usage_examples.text_mt: It-tlaħħiq mal-ispejjeż sar aktar diffiċli din is-sena.
usage_examples.text_en: Keeping up with expenses became harder this year.

definitions.text_en: promoted, appointed, caught up, up to date
definitions.text_mt: Li ġie maħtur f'grad jew kariga ogħla, jew li żamm ruħu fil-ħin mal-bqija.

usage_examples.mt: Bħala uffiċjal mlaħħaq ġdid, beda x-xogħol b'entużjażmu.
usage_examples.en: As a newly promoted officer, he started work with enthusiasm.

definitions.text_en: regulating, regulation, adjustment
definitions.text_mt: Il-kontroll, ir-ranġar u l-istabbiliment ta' ordni u bilanċ f'sistema jew f'imġiba.

usage_examples.mt: Ir-rregolar tal-ħinijiet għen ħafna lill-ħaddiema.
usage_examples.en: Regulating the working hours helped the workers greatly.
